reason: I want to make the cut so platelets can gather at the damaged vessel, as the chapter describes.
expectation: The rough edge will break the skin and a small blood vessel, creating a place for a platelet plug.

alternatives.reason: The enzyme label explains that this should make reinforcing threads, but I want to make the break first.

effect: The cut reaches a leaking blood vessel, so there is now a place to form the plug.
reaction: The cut makes the repair goal clear.
reason: The platelets are shown sticking to the torn vessel, so I'll gather them at the break.
expectation: The platelets will form a plug that helps slow the leak, though it may still need reinforcing threads.

alternatives.reason: The enzymes can make reinforcing threads, but I want to form the plug first.

effect: The platelet plug slows the leak, but the surface cut remains open and the plug still needs reinforcement.
reaction: Seeing the platelets pile up makes their role clear.
reason: This is the only available combination, and the enzyme label says it helps the clotting protein form threads.
expectation: The protein and enzymes will form threads that can reinforce the plug.

effect: The clotting proteins formed a mesh, and the new goal is to stop the bleeding.
reaction: The branching mesh makes the idea of reinforcement clear.
reason: The only offered combination brings the threads to the platelet plug to reinforce it.
expectation: The mesh will strengthen the plug and stop the bleeding, though the skin cut may still need repair.

effect: The reinforced plug stopped the bleeding, but the skin above it still needs to heal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the mesh and platelets work together, though the open cut makes the repair feel unfinished.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the threads to the plug was most worthwhile because it brought the two parts together and stopped the leak.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was a straightforward setup rather than an interesting decision.

surprise.text: The bleeding stopped even though the surface cut remained open; stopping a leak and healing the skin are separate things.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The enzyme pairing was the only available combination, but its label explained its purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the open skin heals after the bleeding has stopped.
